verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud documents a JavaScript runtime for building agents and custom business logic, so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack shows versioning, review workflows, or rollback for those automations. Data-source segregation for updates is a related but different feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
